spans.s: In Patronymics used in narrower sense (counting first from the grand-child), which are formed the affixes अण् and इञ् , the feminine is formed by substituting य (ष्यङ्) for the अ and इ of those affixes and adding the long आ under -- यङश्चाप्‌

, provided that they do not denote ऋषि clans and have prosodially long syllable preceding the last syllable.

Terms: ष्यङ्

The affix अण् (अ) comes without changing the sense, after a stem ending in the affix इणुन्।

Terms: अण् (अ)

A compound, the second member of which is a word ending in the कृत् -affix अण् and which denotes a functionary, gets the acute accent (उदात्त) on the first syllable.

Terms: समास 1st-acute
